methodHandling.otherMethods: Not checked. Bodyless GET -> 500 'Internal error'; other methods with JSON body behave like POST.

request.parse: Destructures {deckId, number, instruction, attachments} from await req.json() (refine.ts:11-14). Malformed JSON or null -> 500 'Internal error'.

fields.name: deckId
fields.validation: falsy -> 400 'deckId and a valid slide number are required'

fields.name: number
fields.bounds: > 0; NOT checked against the deck's slide count
fields.validation: !Number.isInteger(number) || number <= 0 -> 400 'deckId and a valid slide number are required' (strings like '2' rejected)

fields.name: instruction
fields.validation: (instruction ?? '').trim(); empty -> 400 'instruction is required'; length > 600 -> 400 'instruction is too long (max 600 chars)'. A non-string instruction (e.g. number) -> .trim TypeError -> 500.

fields.name: attachments
fields.bounds: no server-side size or count limit
fields.validation: Silently filtered: kept only if a.type==='image' && typeof a.data==='string' && media_type in [image/jpeg,image/png,image/gif,image/webp]; PDFs and malformed entries dropped without error. A non-array truthy value (object/string) -> .filter TypeError -> 500 (a string has no .filter).

checkOrder: 7. best-effort: readJobState; if a state exists set slides[number] = {...existing ?? {status:'idle'}, status:'generating'} and writeJobState (errors logged, swallowed)
9. triggerRefineBackground({deckId, userId, number, instruction: trimmed, attachments: filtered}) — failures swallowed

body.error: deckId and a valid slide number are required

errors.when: deckId falsy or number not a positive integer
malformed/null JSON; non-string instruction; non-array attachments; non-UUID deckId; Supabase error in ownsDeck

sideEffects: Job-state blob: target slide status -> 'generating' synchronously before the 202 (only if a job-state blob exists) (refine.ts:32-40)
Background trigger -> refine-background (OpenAI image edit, new version v{n})
externalCalls: Supabase; Netlify Blobs; background OpenAI image edit — PAID
quirks: The pre-mark to 'generating' is synchronous so the first /api/status poll after the 202 is non-terminal (refine.ts:25-30); both pre-mark writes swallow errors and the 202 is still returned (_tests/refine.test.ts:46-51).
A slide number not in the deck is accepted: the job state gains a new slide {status:'generating'} (refine.ts:35-36), so /api/status shows a phantom slide and progress total increases.
Attachments are silently filtered; PDFs dropped (comment refine.ts:20).
The trigger receives the trimmed instruction.
No refine cap/budget is enforced server-side (the Connector enforces its own spend budget, forge.py:701-702).
beforeAnyState: Non-existent deck -> 403. Owned deck with no job-state blob: blob pre-mark skipped, DB pre-mark attempted, 202 returned.

tests.asserts: empty instruction 400 and no trigger; 403 non-owner; 202 + trigger {deckId,userId,number:2,instruction:'fewer words'}; synchronous DB + job-state pre-mark; 202 even when DB pre-mark fails (lines 14-51)

callers.where: app/api/routes/forge.py:698-731 (/forge/refine) sends only {deckId, number, instruction} (no attachments)
callers.expects: status < 400 else 502 'Refine failed (<code>).'; reads resp.json().deckId with fallback to the request deckId
